def redact(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        # Redact authorization, token, password, and api_key values
        patterns = [
            r'(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*["\']?)[^\s"\']+(["\']?)',
            r'(?i)(token\s*[:=]\s*["\']?)[^\s"\']+(["\']?)',
            r'(?i)(password\s*[:=]\s*["\']?)[^\s"\']+(["\']?)',
            r'(?i)(api_key\s*[:=]\s*["\']?)[^\s"\']+(["\']?)',
        ]
        result = value
        for pattern in patterns:
            result = re.sub(pattern, r'\g<1>***REDACTED***\g<2>', result)
        return result
    return value"
